_context.menu.app.about: macOS application menu item. {name} is the app name (Rerun, Rerun Staging).
_context.menu.app.hide: macOS application menu item that hides the app. {name} is the app name.
_context.menu.app.hideOthers: macOS application menu item that hides every other app.
_context.menu.app.quit: Menu item quitting the app. {name} is the app name.
_context.menu.view.reload: Menu item reloading the page shown in the window.
_context.menu.view.actualSize: Menu item resetting the zoom of the page to 100%.
_context.menu.help.docs: Menu item opening the documentation website in the browser.
_context.offline.title: Shown in the app window when the Rerun server cannot be reached.
_context.offline.body: {host} is the server address, for example app.rerun.build.
_context.offline.unavailable: Shown when the server answered with an error (during a deploy, for example).
_context.unload.message: Native dialog shown when the person closes or reloads the window while a coworker is working or a file has unsaved edits.
_context.find.matches: Find in page bar: position of the highlighted match among all matches.
_context.server.title: Page where a person who hosts Rerun themselves enters the address of their server.
_context.server.notRerun: The address answered, but it is not a Rerun server.
_context.server.tooOld: The server runs a Rerun version too old for this app. {version} is the oldest app version it accepts, or the server's own version.
_context.server.insecure: Warning under the address field when the address uses http:// on another machine.
_context.incompatible.title: Shown when the desktop app is older than the oldest version the server accepts.
_context.updates.upToDateDetail: Native dialog after Check for Updates. {version} is like 0.4.0.
_context.updates.readyToInstall: Native dialog title when an update was downloaded. {version} is like 0.4.0.
_context.tray.open: Tray menu item that shows the app window. {name} is the app name.
_context.tray.waiting: In the tray menu and tooltip: how many conversations wait for the person.
_context.tray.stillRunning: Windows balloon the first time the window is closed into the notification area. {name} is the app name.
_context.context.openLink: Right-click menu on a link: opens it in the web browser.
_context.tray.quickAsk: Tray menu item opening the small window where the person types a question for the Chief of Staff (the workspace assistant), from any app.

offline.title: Can’t reach Rerun
offline.body: Check your connection. The app reconnects to {host} on its own.
offline.unavailable: {host} is not answering right now. The app tries again on its own.

incompatible.title: Update Rerun to continue
incompatible.body: This version of the app is too old for {host}.

unload.detail: A coworker is still working or a file has unsaved changes.

server.title: Connect to your server
server.description: Enter the address of the Rerun server you use.
server.label: Server address
server.notRerun: This address is not a Rerun server.
server.tooOld: This server needs version {version} of the app or later.
server.insecure: This address is not encrypted. Use https:// unless the server runs on this computer.

updates.readyDetail: The app restarts to finish the update.

tray.waiting: {count, plural, one {# waiting for you} other {# waiting for you}}
tray.stillRunning: {name} keeps running here. Quit it from this icon.
